Classification: High Clan

The @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.GaCuLGcjZZjf2EO6]{Toreador}, called the Artisans, resist the emotional distancing the Embrace usually brings by maintaining close ties to mortals and mortal art. Clan legend holds that their founder Arikel was cursed by Caine himself to be forever distracted by beauty, after a sculpture she made displeased him; through appreciation of beauty, however, Toreador retain some understanding of the human condition. The clan is deeply entwined with the Church (as patrons, clergy-turned-vampires, or seekers of redemption) and with noble courts, having created the Courts of Love, now a major power in the War of Princes.

Disciplines: Auspex, Celerity, Presence

Advantage: All Toreador begin with two free Traits of Academics, Crafts, Performance or Subterfuge (in any combination). Toreador also attract mortals readily and may expend such Abilities to gain a Blood Trait (15 minutes out of play and one level of Ability per Trait gained).

Disadvantage: Toreador risk falling into a reverie of study whenever they encounter a piece of art (Crafts, Expression, or Performance rated three or greater) or a person who strikes their fancy. The reverie breaks only via a Self-Control/Instinct Challenge against four Traits, a surprise attack, or the object leaving their presence.

Organization: No central hierarchy; Toreador cluster around patronage networks, artistic circles, and the Courts of Love.

Suggested Viae: Humanity, Kings.
